info.name: NEMBUS API
info.description: NEMBUS Backend API. All routes from routing + JWT/Tenant middleware. Use x-tenant-id and Bearer token. Select NEMBUS Local environment.

request.description: Use form-data file upload; module: products, categories, brands, etc.
Apply a coupon to a cart. Supports: percentage_discount, fixed_discount, buy_x_get_y, happy_hour, points_multiplier, bundle_price, free_item.
Check if a coupon is valid without applying it. Returns errors and estimated discount.
Returns the current active rule used at POS checkout to compute point value.
Lightweight POS check before redemption. Returns id, name, and loyalty_points.
Pass a negative value to redeem/deduct. Pass a positive value to grant bonus points.

item.name: Product Catalog
item.description: Admin product catalog — master products with embedded variants and inventory stock per storage location.

query.description: Required. Scopes results to this organization.
Optional. Filter by category ID. Leave blank or 0 for all.

request.description:
Returns master products with two embedded arrays:
- `variants`: product variants (id, variant_sku, variant_name, variant_attributes, is_active)
- `inventory`: stock levels per storage location (stock_id, store_id, storage_location_id, storage_location_name, storage_location_code, product_variant_id, quantity_on_hand, quantity_available, quantity_allocated, quantity_on_order, reorder_level, reorder_quantity, max_stock_level)

Products with no variants/stock return empty arrays [].

item.name: List Products with Variants & Inventory (by Category)

query.description: Filter by this specific category ID.

request.description: Same as the base catalog request but filtered to a single category_id.

item.name: Backup
item.description:
HTTP management endpoints for the gRPC backup streaming service.

All routes require Bearer auth + x-tenant-id header (inherited from collection).

Actual byte-level streaming happens over gRPC — use the gRPC subfolder or the CLI client.

request.description: Returns whether a gRPC backup stream is currently active for the tenant and how many bytes have been sent. Polls the live in-memory state of the gRPC server.
Returns the gRPC server address + tenant slug so a POS terminal or offline app can configure its gRPC client and call BackupService.StreamBackup directly.

Starts an async server-side backup job. The pg_dump output is saved to ./backups/ on the server (not streamed to the caller). Returns a job_id. Set compressed=true to use pg_dump --format=custom (smaller file, restore with pg_restore).
Poll the status of a specific backup job (running / done / failed). backup_job_id is set automatically by the Trigger request test script.
Returns all server-side backup jobs (running, done, failed) held in memory for this server instance.

item.name: gRPC — StreamBackup (Streaming)
item.description:
gRPC server-streaming call. Use Postman v10.20+ with gRPC support, or use the CLI client:

  go run ./cmd/backup-client -server {{grpc_url}} -tenant {{tenant_slug}} -token <JWT>

Server address: {{grpc_url}} (default: localhost:50051)
Proto file: proto/backup.proto

request.description:
Server-streaming RPC. The server runs pg_dump and sends the output as 32 KB BackupChunk messages until the dump is complete. Each chunk includes:
- data: raw bytes
- offset: cumulative bytes sent
- sha256: hex checksum of this chunk
- is_last: true on the final sentinel chunk

Service: backup.BackupService
Method: StreamBackup
Proto: proto/backup.proto

Unary RPC — returns the live streaming progress for the given tenant slug (bytes_sent, in_progress, started_at). Useful for polling from a separate client goroutine while StreamBackup is running.

Service: backup.BackupService
Method: BackupStatus
Proto: proto/backup.proto
